_comment: Traditional face-reading corpus. FOLKLORE, NOT SCIENCE (plan §4). Each entry reports what a named tradition CLAIMS about a facial feature; it never asserts truth. The `feature` values must match the keys produced by core/features.py so retrieval can join them. This is a schema-lock seed of 4 entries -- grow it by hand over the project (plan §11).

entries.claim: associated with strong will, drive, and abundant energy
entries.source: Traditional mian xiang (physiognomy) teachings; e.g. Lillian Too, 'Chinese Face Reading'

entries.claim: linked to a careful, reserved temperament in the tradition
historically read as balanced and diplomatic
entries.source: Western physiognomic folklore (e.g. 19th c. popular physiognomy manuals)

entries.claim: said to signal warmth, generosity, and expressiveness
